files.description: Files written under the generated dir, as run-relative paths.

changed_files.description: Baseline files edited, as paths relative to the worktree's pomo/ root, e.g. 'POMO/CVRPEnv.py'. A renamed copy (CVRPTWEnv.py) belongs in neither this list nor the deliverable.

written_back.description: Paths under the generated dir that received an edited baseline file, e.g. 'pomo/POMO/CVRPEnv.py'. Unchanged baseline files must not appear here.

new_files.description: Files created that the baseline does not have. Expected to be empty apart from run.py and the train/test entry points; anything else is a contract violation to justify in 'assumptions'.
